{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of all 101 of the [[ultra-prominent peak]]s (with [[topographic prominence]] greater than 1,500 metres) in [[West Asia]]. It includes peaks on the islands of Cyprus and Socotra. It also includes the 10 ultras of the [[Caucasus]] (also listed under [[List of European ultra prominent peaks#Caucasus Mountains|Europe]]) as they are also geographically connected to the mountains of West Asia. Two of these peaks (Mount Aragats and Kapudzhukh Lerr) are on the Asian side of the ridge of the Greater Caucasus, which forms the [[boundary between Asia and Europe]], and four more are on the border itself and so in both Europe and Asia.
